# IACAD reference fixtures

`iacad_dubai_ramadan_2026.csv` contains the Dubai prayer-time rows published in
IACAD's official Ramadan in Dubai 2026 / 1447 AH calendar:

<https://iacad.gov.ae/assets/b4d53ecb/ramadan-in-dubai-2026-ad-1447-ah.aspx>

The rows cover 18 February through 19 March 2026. They validate the `iacad_dubai`
profile only for that published period; they are not evidence of year-round or future
IACAD equivalence. The IACAD source accessed for this investigation did not publish
the calculation coordinates, so tests use the documented comparison assumption of
latitude `25.2048`, longitude `55.27055`, and timezone `Asia/Dubai`.
